description: Nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic activities are not approved, controlled, or monitored.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for absence of approval processes for remote maintenance, lack of monitoring for nonlocal maintenance sessions, missing authentication requirements for remote access, and no records of remote maintenance activities.
